## History

Miss Rogerson is a middle-aged Sunday-school teacher who has taught her class for twenty years. When [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) attends Sunday-school alone in a dress decorated with wild flowers, she is placed in Miss Rogerson's class. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later recounts her experiences with Miss Rogerson and the other children to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
